title: Presales Solutions Architect
description:
About PhoenixAI

PhoenixAI is the Agentic AI Database, purpose-built to give autonomous AI agents sub-second access to live enterprise data at massive scale. The platform unifies real-time and at-rest data in a single AI-native engine, combining the speed and concurrency that agentic workloads demand with the governance and deployment flexibility enterprises require to put AI into production. Formerly known as CelerData, PhoenixAI is headquartered in Menlo Park, California. Learn more at phoenixdata.ai

About the role

We are seeking a talented Presales Solutions Architect to join our team and play a pivotal role in the sales cycle for our Agentic Database. You’ll partner with our sales team to guide prospects through the technical evaluation of PhoenixAI, delivering compelling presentations or demos, architecting tailored AI-native solutions, and securing technical wins. This customer-facing role requires a blend of deep technical expertise, strong communication skills, and a passion for solving complex data challenges.

What you'll do

As a Presales Solutions Architect, you’ll partner with sales to secure technical wins by showcasing PhoenixAI’s Agentic Database value and driving successful evaluations. Your responsibilities include:

• Technical Advocacy: Act as a trusted advisor, demonstrating PhoenixAI’s capabilities—like its vectorized query engine, lakehouse analytics, and multi-table joins for agentic AI workloads—via presentations, customized demos, and Proof of Concept (PoC).

• Solution Design: Work with prospects to understand their needs (e.g., data scale, latency, integrations) and architect PhoenixAI-based solutions to meet their goals.

• PoC Execution: Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of PoCs, ensuring prospects experience PhoenixAI’s Agentic Database performance and usability firsthand.

• Documentation: Keep detailed records of evaluations—covering use cases, challenges, PoC plans, and outcomes—to refine our process and inform product enhancements to PhoenixAI’s Agentic Database.

• Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate with sales to align technical discussions with business goals, address objections, and close deals, while gathering customer insights to shape PhoenixAI’s Agentic Database roadmap with product and engineering teams.

• Marketing Support & Thought Leadership: Boost PhoenixAI’s presence by delivering webinars, staffing conference booths, speaking at user groups, and writing blogs on Agentic AI use cases and best practices.

Qualifications

• Ambition & Curiosity: A driven, inquisitive mindset—eager to learn PhoenixAI Agentic Database product’s intricacies, tackle tough challenges, and grow into the role, even if starting with less experience or specific skills.

• Experience: 3+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or technical consulting role, ideally within the data analytics, database, or cloud infrastructure space.

• Technical Expertise:

•

• Hands-on experience of OLAP workloads, query optimization, and data modeling (e.g., star schema, snowflake schema)

• Proficiency in SQL.

• Deep understanding of distributed data processing system theory.

• Familiar with at least one of the public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)

• Communication Skills: Proven ability to distill complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives for diverse stakeholders, from engineers to C-level executives.

• Problem-Solving: Adept at troubleshooting technical challenges during PoCs and adapting solutions to meet unique customer needs.

• Sales Mindset: Experience supporting sales teams in technical evaluations, with a track record of securing technical wins and driving revenue growth.

• Bonus Points:

•

• Knowledge of BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker)

• Experience with streaming processing systems (Kafka, Redpanda, etc.)

The base salary for this role is projected at $150,000-$200,000 annually, plus eligibility for PhoenixAI's bonus and equity programs.

Individual compensation will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. We also provide a comprehensive benefits package featuring premium medical, dental, and vision coverage, life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan. Employees enjoy at least 16 days of PTO, parental leave, health savings options, and access to our employee assistance program.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who has already managed high-stakes events at a tech startup — ideally in the data, infrastructure, or SaaS space — and understands how to allocate resources, manage vendors, and drive measurable outcomes.

Events are a key growth channel for PhoenixAI. The current program includes a monthly technical meetup (in the Bay Area and other U.S. cities), quarterly executive receptions for key customers, and a presence at major industry conferences such as AWS re:Invent. Our events motion is anchored in the StarRocks open-source community, and this role works closely with DevRel and Community to turn that community into a recurring, high-quality in-person program. The Field Marketing Manager will own the full lifecycle of PhoenixAI's in-person events — strategy, budget, execution, and reporting — working cross-functionally to bring the right people and content into each program.

• Build and run a monthly technical meetup program in the Bay Area and other cities, drawing speakers and co-hosts from the StarRocks community, customers, and partners, in close coordination with DevRel.

• Plan and host quarterly executive receptions for key customers in partnership with Sales and Customer Success, focused on relationship depth, expansion, and advocacy.

• Lead PhoenixAI's presence at major industry conferences and partner events (e.g., AWS re:Invent) — sponsorship selection, booth, speaking opportunities, and on-site execution.

• Leverage the open-source data ecosystem — community members, other project communities, local meetup organizers — to source speakers, co-hosts, and venues for our events.

• Define the specific objective for each event before it happens — e.g., lead generation, pipeline influence, brand awareness, or customer engagement — and design the event and its metrics around that goal.

• Handle venue selection, sponsorship arrangements, vendor relationships, catering, booth setup, signage, promotional items, shipping, and travel logistics.

• Develop event schedules and keep colleagues, speakers, partners, and vendors aligned and on track.

• Produce landing pages, invites, social content, email outreach, and other materials to promote events.

• Work with speakers on presentations, demos, and run-of-show planning.

• Bring in internal technical resources — such as Product Management, Solutions Architects, and Engineering — to support event content and demos where needed.

• Partner with Sales ahead of each event to define target accounts, meeting objectives, and follow-up plans.

• Make sure leads gathered at events are logged accurately and passed along to Sales without delay.

• Capture and repurpose event content — recordings, photos, speaker decks — with the content and social teams.

• Coordinate with the team that owns webinars to align calendars and cross-promote where in-person and virtual programs overlap.

• Track and report on performance against the stated goal for each event (MQLs/SQLs generated, pipeline influence, awareness metrics, community growth, customer engagement, or similar).

• Keep an up-to-date calendar of upcoming conferences, sponsorship options, and community gatherings.

Qualifications

• 5+ years of field or event marketing experience at a fast-growing tech startup, ideally in the data, infrastructure, or SaaS space.

• Proven experience organizing events for an open-source or developer community — running meetups, community days, contributor gatherings, or community tracks at conferences. This is required.

• An existing network in the open-source data ecosystem (e.g., StarRocks, Apache projects, Linux Foundation events, or the broader data engineering community) that you can draw on for speakers, co-hosts, and venues is strongly preferred.

• Track record of running events end-to-end in a fast-moving, resource-constrained environment, from large conference sponsorships to small executive hospitality events.

• Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with internal technical stakeholders such as Solutions Architects, Product Managers, and DevRel.

• Strong vendor and budget management skills.

• Familiarity with event and community tooling (e.g., Luma, Bevy, Splash) and marketing automation / CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce).

• Comfortable engaging with technical speakers, partners, prospective customers, sales, and executive leadership.

• Willingness to travel for events and work evenings/weekends as needed around event schedules.

• Must currently be based in the San Francisco Bay Area.

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

When applying, please include 2–3 community or field events you have organized and your role in each.
